set.body:
Objective
Define bounded supported persistence profiles for results/artifacts without a new codec registry. Preserve axis/value/plan identity, reducer coverage, model interpretation and qualifications.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements OPS-01, OPS-02, FND-06, GLB-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
artifact integration; existing estimates/archive IO boundaries; global and frame result adapters. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M1.04, M3.02, M3.10. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Every supported durable profile reopens in a fresh process without its fitter and preserves scientific validity/coverage and payload integrity.
2. Unavailable profiles are explicitly in-memory/unsupported, not opaque bytes pretending to be universal estimates.
3. Checkpoint state is distinct from a completed fitted artifact; compatibility checks cover source revisions, scoped fits, seeds and reducer state.
4. No automatic upload/publication or privacy-sensitive payload dumping; native bounded views reference large payloads.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt estimatesIoJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt estimatesIoJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M3.11: Admit durable typed artifact profiles through existing archive/estimate facilities
